## TRA Timeline

#### Underlying Stronghold TRA (referenced; documents not in this directory)

- 2021-04-01: Stronghold Digital Mining, Inc. executes the Tax Receivable Agreement at its IPO close with Q Power LLC; 85% of cash tax savings on basis step-ups from Company Holdco unit redemptions plus imputed interest
- 2022-11-09: Joinder adds William Spence as an additional TRA Party

#### Bitfarms acquisition and TRA Waiver and Termination Agreement

- 2024-08-21: TRA Waiver and Termination Agreement executed alongside the merger agreement; waives the Section 4.2 Change-of-Control Early Termination Payment in full, with no substitute negotiated cash payment (Stronghold holders' consideration is the all-stock merger at 2.52 Bitfarms shares per Stronghold share)
- 2024-08-22: Merger agreement filed via 6-K
- 2025-01-28: Waiver and Termination Agreement filed as Annex C of the acquisition 424B3 prospectus
- 2025-03-14: Bitfarms-Stronghold merger closes; TRA Waiver becomes operative and the Stronghold TRA is terminated in its entirety

#### Acquirer redomiciliation

- 2026-04-01: Bitfarms redomiciles to Delaware as Keel Infrastructure Corp.; no further TRA activity under this CIK

## Explanation

The TRA in scope here is Stronghold Digital Mining's April 2021 Tax Receivable Agreement, under which Stronghold paid Q Power LLC and (after a November 2022 joinder) William Spence 85% of the cash tax savings on Section 754 basis step-ups from Company Holdco unit redemptions plus imputed interest. Bitfarms (now Keel Infrastructure Corp.) was the acquirer, not the obligor: in the August 21, 2024 TRA Waiver and Termination Agreement signed alongside the merger agreement, the holders waived the Section 4.2 Change-of-Control Early Termination Payment in full without a substitute cash payment and agreed to terminate the TRA in its entirety effective at merger close. The Bitfarms-Stronghold merger closed March 14, 2025; the TRA was extinguished at that point. The underlying Stronghold TRA contract documents live under Stronghold's CIK 0001856028 and are referenced here for context. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
